One turn of the rotation (Main hall, nothing else on air)
Photos and clips: nothing yet · Who is playing and in voice: the bot is not connected · Food after 18:30: no open order

Each item shows 30–60 s (45 s here). Every change is a crossfade with a short move from the theme's motion vocabulary, about 1.2 s; never a cut. The order and the switches are the organiser's, per zone (sheet 06).
A moment that takes the hero pauses nothing: the rotation's clock runs on underneath, and when the hero is free again it fades back in where the clock has it.
The venue rail takes turns too: food, Wi-Fi and the hub QR, one turn each, so the hub QR is up at least every 2:15. What the hero shows, the rail and the ticker leave out.
The slideshow playlist takes the hero (D6a): one run of the playlist is one turn, and every second run plays clean
Its turn follows Photos and clips (D1); the lane above leaves it out to show the 45 s turns. A run is the playlist once through, at most 5 minutes.

svg.text: Only what is needed, for 15 s at a slide change: here the open order.
Nothing on top, first slide to last; the rail and ticker carry the rest.
No hero in the layout: a run takes the screen every 10 min.
The Main hall's hero from 18:05 to 18:30: four runs of the demo loop (8 slides, 2:40 a run) between the rotation's items
The rule: run numbers come from the rotation's clock, so every screen of the zone agrees; even runs are clean. On the others a lower third (at most a sixth of the region's height) may
appear for 15 s at a slide change, at most twice a run, one at a time, with only an open food order, food on the way, or the next item when it starts within 15 minutes.
Anything that needs more is a moment and takes the hero by its rank (D6), as the last call does at 18:25; over a run, the playlist fades out under it the same way.
